clusters.name: The Sovereign Self
clusters.thesis: You can be free from anything except the thing doing the freeing.

clusters.name: Of the State
clusters.thesis: The state keeps re-forming, and its contract is written by whoever holds the leverage.

clusters.name: Faith Without Altars
clusters.thesis: Meaning cannot be handed to an institution and still be yours.

clusters.name: Of Machines
clusters.thesis: What is sold as intelligence or culture is often an average with the author removed.
